loglevel.description: Logging verbosity: 0 = silent, 1 = errors only, 2 = warnings, 3 = info, 4 = debug

logfile.description: Path to log file (e.g., '/var/log/nbdkit.log'). Empty or 'syslog' routes to syslog

logflush.description: Flush log output after every write (for real-time debugging)

listen.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces)

port.description: TCP port number for NBD connections

unixsocket.description: Path to Unix domain socket (e.g., '/var/run/nbdkit.sock'). If set, `port` is ignored

allow_disk_create.description: Allow disk creation via NBD_CMD_FLUSH or write-zeroes (dangerous; enables write access even with read-only clients)

read_only.description: Force all connections to be read-only (overrides client write attempts)

plugin_path.description: Search paths for plugin shared libraries (colon-separated). Do not change unless installing custom plugins

servers.description: List of NBD export definitions — each creates a separate server endpoint

name.description: Unique name of the server (used as section header)

plugin.description: Name of the nbdkit plugin to use (e.g., 'file', 'memory', 'curl')

args.description: Key–value arguments passed to the plugin (e.g., { 'path': '/data/disk.img', 'readonly': true })
